course_name_en: Political Developments-Social Movements in the 20th Century

learning_outcomes.text: Students gain general knowledge about 20th century Turkey and the world, and are informed about current academic studies.
Students learn new skills and techniques for social analysis.
Students learn new skills in preparing articles/assignments at the undergraduate level.
Students learn to develop a comparative perspective.
Students master fundamental terminology in political science.

syllabus_topics: A General Overview of the 20th Century
World War I and the Dissolution of Empires, War and Revolution: October 1917
Post-War Mass Culture, Science and Schools of Thought
The 1929 Great Depression, the Rise of Fascism, World War II
Turkey during and after World War II
New Models, Alternative Formations, and the Independence of Colonies
The Revival and End of the Cold War I
The Revival and End of the Cold War II
The Middle East and its Problems I
The Middle East and its Problems II
New World Order: European Union and New Conservatism
